description: Create, update, hide, show or delete a desk workspace (shortcuts, link cards, number cards, charts) with its left sidebar and desktop icon; app-owned workspaces are copied, never edited in place (needs approval)

operation.description: disable/enable hide/show a public workspace (Workspace Managers still see it); delete removes it with its own sidebar and desktop icon

name.description: The workspace title (create) or name; a sidebar-only update names the sidebar

public.description: create: 1 (default) for everyone, 0 for the requester only (listed in My Workspaces)

copy_from.description: create: start from a copy of this workspace and its sidebar (the way to change an app workspace)

icon.description: A Frappe icon name (lucide: home, users, receipt-text, chart-column…) or an emoji

roles.description: Only these roles see it; empty = every desk user

cards.description: Replaces all link cards, in order

number_cards.description: Replaces the number cards: names or {name, label}

charts.description: Replaces the charts: names or {name, label}

content.description: Advanced: the exact block layout [{id, type, data}] (customize.get returns the current one)

sidebar.description: Replaces the left menu: {items: [...], header_icon} or {remove: 1}. Item: {type: Link|Section Break|Spacer, label, link_type: DocType|Page|Report|Workspace|Dashboard|URL, link_to, url, icon, child, collapsible, keep_closed}. A Section Break may hold its links in items: [...]

desktop_icon.description: A tile on /desk for a public workspace (default 1 on create)
